jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

The **Product Manager Trainer** accelerates **referral growth** from local healthcare networks into our fertility clinic. You will own **Sales training completion rates** as a core metric, designing targeted local enablement programs. Additionally, you will spend significant time in the field, joining reps on **doctor visits** to deliver scientific presentations to OB-GYNs, urologists, and women’s health specialists.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* **Referral Growth:** Drive a measurable increase in patient referrals from targeted local medical practices.
* **Sales Training Completion Rates:** Maintain a **95% or higher completion rate** on all product onboarding and monthly refresher training modules.
* **HCP Engagement:** Achieve specific monthly targets for high-impact joint doctor visits and clinical presentations.
* **Pitch Certification:** Ensure 100% of local sales reps pass a quarterly scientific pitch certification exam.

Pay: ₹13,000.00 - ₹51,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Dynamics 365 and Power Platform depend on a core data platform that manages business data, transactions, security, extensibility, and application lifecycle at enterprise scale. As customers modernize their applications and adopt AI, the platform must keep data governed, available, and economically sustainable while supporting the controls expected of enterprise business systems.

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead product strategy for the core data platform behind Microsoft business applications. You will own cross-platform governance policy, commercial trade-offs, and investment priorities across Dataverse and Finance and Operations data-platform capabilities, including data governance and lifecycle management, storage economics, integration, reliability, scale, and the partner ecosystem. You will also guide how supported interfaces and emerging agent integrations build on that foundation. The portfolio spans important Finance & Operations (F&O) scenarios and shared platform capabilities used across Dynamics 365 and Power Platform.

This Hyderabad-based role offers broad product ownership at an important point in the evolution of enterprise applications: shaping the data foundation used by business applications, analytics, and AI. You will work closely with engineering teams, Dynamics 365 and Power Platform product teams, Microsoft AI product groups, customers, and ecosystem partners, with regular exposure to senior leaders as you drive decisions that are visible in customer experience and business results. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, DSP Tech
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Do you want to be part of the team that transforms how safety decisions are made for Amazon's Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) across 21 countries? Are you passionate about building intelligent, data driven platforms that protect delivery associates every single day?  
  
DSP SafetyTech is a newly formed team serving as the intelligence layer between safety signals and decisions — interpreting what happened, routing it to who can act, and ensuring no safety event goes unresolved. Today, safety data is fragmented across seven systems with no single technical owner, causing attribution errors, reconciliation gaps, and duplicated logic. We're changing that.  
  
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to help build a governed safety intelligence platform. You will contribute to three critical pillars: Safety Data as a Service (SDaaS), a governed serving layer consolidating telematics, incidents, and contextual enrichment; DSP Facing Mechanisms, a unified configuration layer managing compound signals and business rules across DSP facing surfaces; and Advanced Analytics and Agentic Capabilities, predictive models and AI agents that provide actionable safety insights.  
  
This is a rare opportunity to join a team building a platform from the ground up that will directly impact the safety of delivery associates worldwide.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design, develop, test, and deploy software components for a governed data serving platform that consolidates telematics, incident reports, video evidence, and contextual enrichment from multiple upstream systems
* Build and maintain backend services and APIs that support a unified configuration layer where safety business rules are authored, validated, versioned, and distributed
* Develop frontend components for a consolidated safety dashboard, a single view where signals, scorecard outcomes, alerts, event video, and interventions come together

• Implement compound safety signals that combine individual data sources into higher order, actionable safety indicators • Write clean, maintainable, and well tested code following software engineering best practices
  

* Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and operational excellence activities
* Collaborate with data engineers and data scientists to integrate data pipelines and model outputs into production services
* Contribute to automated evidence preservation mechanisms to address short video retention windows
* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, participating in on call rotations to ensure system reliability
* Work with cross functional teams including product managers, stakeholders across investigations, claims, insurance, and accountability to understand requirements and deliver solutions

  
A day in the life  
You will be part of a team building the safety intelligence backbone for Amazon's DSP ecosystem. Your day may involve writing and reviewing code for backend services, building frontend features for the safety dashboard, discussing design approaches with your team, or debugging a production issue. You will collaborate closely with data engineers and data scientists to bring data driven capabilities to life. You'll participate in sprint planning, stand ups, and retrospectives, contributing ideas to improve both the product and the development process. You will have the opportunity to learn and grow across the full stack, from data pipelines to user facing experiences, while working on a platform that scales across multiple countries.  
  
About the team  
DSP Safety Tech is a newly established team with a clear mission: convert every safety event into a clear, trusted action for every DSP, in every market, every time. Our North Star is ensuring every safety signal reaches the people who can act on it, with the context needed to make timely decisions, so risks are identified earlier, decisions are made consistently, and every Delivery Associate goes home safely.  
  
We operate at the intersection of data engineering, applied science, and product development, serving stakeholders from investigators to insurance to DSP owners themselves. We're building from the ground up with a strong vision, executive sponsorship, and the freedom to innovate across the full stack, from governed data pipelines to AI powered agentic experiences.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

In this role, you will serve as the bridge between commercial stakeholders and our advanced AI engineering team.

You must possess a deep understanding of business domains alongside a strong technical grounding in Artificial Intelligence, Large Language Models (LLMs), and autonomous agent workflows. Working closely with our AI Development Lead, you will translate high-level business requirements into granular user stories, actively participate in building Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), and ensure the engineering team is building AI solutions that deliver measurable business impact.

* Partner with the AI Development Lead to deconstruct high-level product features into comprehensive Work Breakdown Structures (WBS)
* Write highly descriptive, value-driven Epics and User Stories with clear Acceptance Criteria that account for the non-deterministic nature of AI outputs
* Own, groom, and prioritize the product backlog based on ROI, user impact, and technical dependencies defined by the engineering lead
* Translate complex business rules and industry domain knowledge into logic that AI engineers can use to build agent prompts, tools, and cognitive routing
* Work with the engineering team to define what success looks like for AI agents, helping establish performance benchmarks, evaluation datasets, and user feedback loops
* Actively participate in daily standups, sprint planning, and sprint reviews, acting as the ultimate voice of the customer

**Requirements**

* 10-15 years of experience in Product Management, including defining Product Vision and owning the Product Roadmap
* Expertise in Agile or SAFe frameworks, with extensive experience working as a Product Owner in Scrum or Kanban environments
* Understanding of AI Solutions, AI Content Framework, and AI Risk Management
* Knowledge of Generative AI, LLM capabilities (e.g., Google Gemini ecosystem), and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
* Familiarity with function calling and multi-agent orchestration concepts (no coding required, but strong conceptual grasp is essential)
* Proven ability to map business processes, identify operational bottlenecks, and quantify the ROI of automation features
* Capability to manage product lifecycles for non-deterministic software where AI outputs are not always 100% predictable
* Proficiency in Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps

* Exceptional ability to explain technical AI constraints to business users and business nuances to technical engineers

* Background in Business Analysis or Systems Analysis with a later specialization in AI/ML products

jobs.description:

You must possess a deep understanding of business domains alongside a strong technical grounding in Artificial Intelligence, Large Language Models (LLMs), and autonomous agent workflows. Working closely with our AI Development Lead, you will translate high-level business requirements into granular user stories, actively participate in building Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), and ensure the engineering team is building AI solutions that deliver measurable business impact.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with business leaders, domain experts, and end-users to discover, define, and document comprehensive business requirements
* Evaluate business problems through an AI lens — determining whether a problem is best solved via deterministic software, traditional ML, or generative AI/agentic workflows
* Define, maintain, and communicate the product roadmap, balancing short-term business wins with long-term technical architecture sustainability
* Partner with the AI Development Lead to deconstruct high-level product features into comprehensive Work Breakdown Structures (WBS)
* Write highly descriptive, value-driven Epics and User Stories. Define clear Acceptance Criteria that account for the non-deterministic nature of AI outputs
* Own, groom, and prioritize the product backlog based on ROI, user impact, and technical dependencies defined by the engineering lead
* Translate complex business rules and industry domain knowledge into logic that AI engineers can use to build agent prompts, tools, and cognitive routing
* Work with the engineering team to define "what success looks like" for AI agents, helping establish performance benchmarks, evaluation datasets, and user feedback loops

* Proven ability to map business processes, identify operational bottlenecks, and quantify the return on investment (ROI) of automation features
* Comfort with managing product lifecycles for non-deterministic software (where AI outputs are not always 100% predictable)
* Extensive experience working as a Product Owner in Scrum or Kanban environments, using tools like Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps
* Proven track record of breaking down complex enterprise requirements into logical, incremental software delivery phases (MVP approach)
* Exceptional ability to explain technical AI constraints to business users and business nuances to technical engineers

**Nice to have**

* Create and maintain data ingestion and transformation workflows that move geospatial and related data into Snowflake for analytics and reporting use cases.
* Develop reusable services and interfaces that connect core applications with GenAI and LLM platforms to enable intelligent querying summarization and recommendation on spatial datasets.

* Create automated testing strategies for geospatial logic data pipelines and integration points to ensure predictable releases and reduced production defects.
* Prepare clear technical documentation covering system architecture data flows API contracts and operational procedures to support maintainability and knowledge sharing.
* Mentor and support team members by reviewing code sharing best practices and encouraging experimentation with new geospatial and GenAI capabilities.
* Engage with stakeholders to present solution options demonstrate features and gather feedback that helps refine the geospatial product roadmap.
* Monitor production systems dashboards and logs to detect performance issues or data quality anomalies and drive timely resolution activities.

**Qualifications**

* Possess a strong background in Java development with extensive experience building backend services and geospatial features for enterprise applications.
* Demonstrate hands on expertise using AWS services such as compute storage messaging and data processing components to deploy and run production workloads.
* Exhibit solid experience with Snowflake including schema design data loading performance tuning and role based access configuration for analytics solutions.
* Show practical exposure to integrating applications with GenAI or LLM platforms including prompt design response handling and governance considerations.
* Apply knowledge of geospatial concepts coordinate systems and spatial indexing along with experience using common geospatial libraries or tools in Java ecosystems.

* Display strong problem solving skills and the ability to investigate production issues perform root cause analysis and implement long term corrective actions.
* Prefer experience with continuous integration and continuous delivery practices that automate build testing and deployment of Java and data components.
* Value prior exposure to agile delivery environments where work is planned in iterations with regular refinement reviews and adaptation to stakeholder feedback.

jobs.title: Engineering Project Manager
jobs.description:
Summary
  
  
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless. Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, we believe hard work, a vibrant working environment, creativity, and innovation are the forces that drive an exceptional customer experience. We treat every customer interaction as an opportunity to delight, engage, and inspire, knowing that obsessing over the smallest details creates the largest impact. Our Customer Systems organization is not just another team: we are a motivated, fast-paced, ever-evolving and closely knit group that builds ultra-fast, thoughtfully designed, carefully crafted solutions, and we are always looking to scale new heights.
  
  
Description
  
  
We are now seeking a passionate Engineering Program Manager to lead and deliver complex programs across our Customer Experience Engineering team. The role sits at the intersection of technology leadership and operational excellence, owning the full lifecycle of initiatives spanning our enterprise contact centre stack and managing technology programs across the applications and products that power Customer Experience engineering. The ideal candidate brings domain expertise in technical program management within a highly cross-functional, multi-faceted business organisation, a strong understanding of the evolving customer service and systems interaction paradigm, and the discipline to drive multi-workstream initiatives across business units. You are a critical problem solver with a genuine passion for user experience and process excellence, comfortable with cutting-edge technologies, and able to articulate complex technical challenges clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. You will own the entire lifecycle of large-scale projects delivered across CXE team areas. You will be in the driver's seat throughout, from business requirements analysis and technical design discussions covering API contracts, data models, and integration patterns, through to testing and partner collaboration. This is not about checking tasks off a list; it is about your ability to lead and deliver on every aspect of the program. You will employ innovative techniques and work collaboratively with team members and business stakeholders across the full development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, development, deployment, testing, and maintenance. You will partner with world-class engineers and cross-functional teams to identify bottlenecks, instrument and analyse systems for performance and reliability, and deliver scalable, intuitive solutions that elevate how customers connect with Apple. Beyond delivery, you will become the product champion, managing product evolution and defining and owning a multi-year product roadmap that shapes where these platforms go next.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* 10+ years of technical program/project management experience delivering complex, multi-stakeholder programs with cross-functional teams on time and within scope.
* Proficiency in Agile (Scrum/Kanban), waterfall, and hybrid delivery methodologies with tooling such as Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, or MS Project.
* Command of program governance frameworks: dependency mapping, risk registers, change management, and stakeholder engagement plans.
* Proven ability to lead and influence engineering teams, product owners, and business stakeholders without direct authority.
* Excellent written, verbal, and organisational skills, tailoring messaging from engineering detail to executive summary with a collaborative ownership mindset.
* Strong architectural knowledge to understand delivered solutions and represent the team independently in business conversations.
* Hands-on software development and operations skills (source control, debugging, testing, deployment, monitoring) to rally a team through incident and release management.
* Self-motivated and analytical, comfortable managing vendors and SOW negotiations across multiple concurrent global programs in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Good understanding of GenAI tools usage in all phases of SDLC & be able to apply to Project/ProgramManagement.
* Experience working in a cross-functional, time-zone distributed team environment.
* Ability to read and reason about system architectures, API contracts (REST/SOAP), data flows, and configuration schemas — sufficient to engage credibly with engineering teams, challenge technical estimates, and assess risks.
* Experience partnering with Quality, Compliance, and Legal teams on initiatives involving GDPR, accessibility, and related standards.
* Experience working with vendors and contractors.
* Engineering/Technical background preferred.

  
  
  

At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.  
  
Learn about accessibility in Apple’s workplace

If a vague ticket bothers you, if you instinctively add detail, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and data fields before a story reaches sprint planning, and if you can hold your own in a technical discussion with developers, we would like to talk to you.

Do you:

* enjoy working closely with engineers on how things get built, not just when?
* want to be part of a fast-moving, growing healthcare technology team?
* want your work to directly improve care for tens of thousands of patients?

**Who we are**

Leap Metrics was founded to improve health outcomes, lower the cost of care, and improve regulatory compliance. Our platform, Sevida, stands for "in the service of human lives," and our team uses technology to serve populations with chronic healthcare needs.

We are experienced technologists, developers, designers, client advocates and entrepreneurs. Leap Metrics is headquartered in the Dallas/Fort Worth Metroplex, with an engineering team in Hyderabad. Learn more at leapmetrics.io.

**Why work with us**

* **Meaningful mission:**
  we help providers focus on care.
* **Real ownership:**
  what you write in JIRA becomes what ships to patients and care teams.
* **Modern stack:**
  React, Node.js, REST/GraphQL APIs, cloud delivery and CI/CD.
* **Culture:**
  a collaborative, supportive startup team at an exciting stage of growth.

**What you will do**

**Product ownership and backlog quality (about half the role)**

* Turn customer, clinical, and business requirements into well-formed JIRA epics and user stories.
* Enrich every story before it reaches sprint planning: clear acceptance criteria, business rules, edge cases, data fields, UI notes or wireframes, API and integration details, and test scenarios.
* Understand the technical design well enough to ask the right questions, spot gaps, and capture dependencies and technical notes in the ticket.
* Own backlog grooming and refinement with the product manager; keep the top of the backlog "ready" at least one sprint ahead.
* Partner with engineering leads to break large features into small, testable increments.
* Review completed work against the acceptance criteria and sign off that it meets the requirement.
* Keep Confluence documentation current so the team has one source of truth.

**Scrum and delivery**

* Facilitate sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews and retrospectives.
* Coordinate frontend, backend, QA and DevOps to keep sprints on track.
* Track velocity, burndown and commitments, and report status, risks and blockers to stakeholders and executives.
* Remove impediments, manage cross-team dependencies, and support release planning.
* Act as the liaison between customers, business teams, engineering and support.
* Coach the team on Agile practices and drive continuous improvement in quality and predictability.

**What you bring**

**Must have**

* 5+ years in Scrum Master, Product Owner, Business Analyst or Agile delivery roles with full-stack software teams.
* A track record of writing detailed user stories and acceptance criteria that developers and QA build and test directly. Be ready to show examples.
* Technical grounding: a background in software development, QA, or technical business analysis, and comfort with discussing APIs, data models, and integrations.
* Strong knowledge of Scrum, Kanban, backlog management and the full SDLC.
* Hands-on expertise in JIRA and Confluence (workflows, boards, epics, filters and reporting).
* Clear written and spoken English; strong facilitation and stakeholder-management skills.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.

**Highly preferred: healthcare product experience**

* Experience building or maintaining healthcare software products.
* Understanding of healthcare workflows, system integrations (HL7/FHIR a plus), patient data privacy and regulatory considerations such as HIPAA.

**Nice to have**

* CSM, PSM, CSPO or PSPO certification.
* Product-based SaaS experience.
* Exposure to React, Node.js, REST APIs, GraphQL and SQL databases.
* Familiarity with CI/CD, release management and cloud delivery.
* Ability to sketch wireframes or simple UI flows.

**Job details**

* **Job type:**
  Full-time
* **Location:**
  Hyderabad, India (hybrid)
* **Benefits:**
  competitive salary, health insurance, paid time off, professional development assistance

**Interview process**

1. Aptitude test.
2. Practical assessment: we give you a business requirement and you turn it into a JIRA-ready epic with user stories, acceptance criteria and technical notes, then show how you would plan and run the sprints to deliver it.
3. Technical Interviews.

jobs.title: Agentic Business Process Analyst
jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  
Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

Crowe’s Microsoft Consulting Practice is hiring an **Agentic Business Process Analyst** to help clients rethink how work gets done in the AI era. This is not a traditional business analyst role focused only on documenting requirements, writing user stories, or mapping current-state processes. This role is for someone who can diagnose business problems, understand root causes, redesign processes, and identify where AI agents, automation, data, and human judgment should come together.

The ideal candidate is deeply functional, process-oriented, and comfortable enough with technology to work side by side with engineers, architects, and client IT teams. This person should be able to bridge business and technology, helping clients move from legacy workflows to intelligent, agent-enabled processes.

This role also has an internal transformation mandate. The person will help upskill Crowe Consulting teams that may be used to traditional ERP, CRM, or business application delivery. They will help consultants develop a more modern mindset: start with problems, then processes, then technology.

**What you will do**

* Lead discovery sessions with clients to understand business goals, pain points, process breakdowns, data issues, user needs, controls, and operating constraints.
* Map end-to-end business processes, including inputs, outputs, roles, systems, decisions, handoffs, exceptions, controls, and performance measures.
* Diagnose root causes across people, process, data, and technology before recommending solutions.
* Identify opportunities for AI assistance, agentic augmentation, workflow orchestration, automation, knowledge retrieval, decision support, and process improvement.
* Partner with technical architects and engineers to translate process opportunities into solution designs, prototypes, functional specifications, user stories, and delivery roadmaps.
* Define business value measures for agentic solutions, such as time saved, cycle time reduction, first-time-right rate, SLA performance, adoption, override rate, CSAT, cost per transaction, revenue lift, and compliance improvement.
* Help clients decide where humans should stay in control, where AI should assist, and where agents can safely orchestrate or automate work.
* Support workshops, demos, process redesign sessions, executive presentations, and change management conversations.
* Create reusable playbooks, templates, process models, and training materials to help Crowe teams adopt an agentic business analysis approach.
* Coach Crowe consultants on how to move beyond legacy requirements gathering into diagnostic, value-led, AI-enabled transformation work.

**What success looks like**

* You can walk into a messy client process and make sense of it quickly.
* You can separate symptoms from root causes.
* You know when the right answer is process redesign, data cleanup, integration, training, governance, automation, or AI.
* You can help clients and internal teams understand what agents should do, what humans should do, and how to measure whether the new process is better.
* You make technical teams sharper by giving them better process context, and you make business teams more confident by helping them understand what technology can realistically do.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 6+ years as a Business Analyst, Functional Consultant, or Process Consultant.
* Strong business process mapping and redesign experience.

jobs.title: Business Analyst – Data In-Licensing & Data Governance
jobs.description:
**Job Description: Business Analyst**
– Data In-Licensing & Data Governance Role: Business Analyst – Data In-Licensing & Data Governance Domain: Life Sciences / Pharmaceutical R&D Engagement Focus: Current-State Assessment, Gap Analysis, Requirements Definition & Future State Roadmap Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst with strong knowledge of data governance, data licensing, data lifecycle management, and enterprise data management practices to support an assessment of the Data In-Licensing process within Novartis Biomedical Research (NIBR). The individual will work closely with business, scientific research, data management, legal, procurement, compliance, and technology stakeholders to assess the current operating model, identify process and technology gaps, and recommend improvements to strengthen governance, compliance, traceability, and operational efficiency across the licensed data lifecycle. Key
**Responsibilities**

1. Data In-Licensing Process Assessment Analyze the end-to-end data in-licensing lifecycle, from data acquisition and contractual agreements through onboarding, provisioning, consumption, renewal, expiry, and retirement. Conduct stakeholder interviews and workshops to understand the current operating model, systems, responsibilities, and pain points. Identify manual activities, fragmented workflows, unclear ownership, and opportunities for automation. Prepare AS-IS process maps, gap assessments, and recommended TO-BE workflows.

2. Data Bill of Materials (DBoM) and License Management Define business requirements for a centralized Data Bill of Materials to track all licensed datasets. Identify essential metadata, including data provider, dataset ownership, licensing terms, permitted usage, restrictions, contractual obligations, renewal dates, expiration timelines, and retention requirements. Assess current mechanisms for tracking licensed datasets and their downstream dependencies. Define requirements for notifications, license renewals, compliance checkpoints, and expiry management.

3. Access Governance and Entitlement Management Assess existing Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and entitlement management processes. Map user roles, access privileges, approval workflows, and data usage restrictions to contractual requirements. Identify gaps in access approvals, access reviews, and entitlement revocation. Define business requirements for visibility into who accesses licensed datasets, for what purpose, and under which permissions.

4. Data Lifecycle and Retention Management Evaluate existing practices for data retention, archival, expiration, and secure deletion. Translate contractual retention and deletion obligations into actionable business requirements. Identify gaps in handling expired licenses, downstream copies, and derived datasets. Define requirements for deletion workflows, approvals, exception handling, and evidence of deletion.

5. Auditability, Data Lineage, and Compliance Assess the organization's ability to trace licensed data from acquisition to consumption. Define requirements for audit trails, usage monitoring, and end-to-end data lineage. Identify gaps in demonstrating compliance with contractual usage restrictions and internal governance policies. Work with risk, legal, and compliance stakeholders to define reporting and audit evidence requirements.

6. Gap Analysis and Future-State Recommendations Consolidate findings into a structured gap assessment covering people, process, technology, and governance. Prioritize gaps based on business impact, contractual exposure, operational risk, and implementation complexity. Develop business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and a prioritized improvement backlog. Collaborate with the Data Engineer and solution architects to define feasible remediation options and a phased implementation roadmap.

**Required Skills and Experience**

• 6–10 years of Business Analysis experience, preferably in pharmaceutical, life sciences, research data, or regulated enterprise environments.

• Experience with data governance, data management, data cataloging, and metadata management.

• Understanding of data licensing, contractual data usage restrictions, and third-party data management.

• Strong knowledge of RBAC, access governance, data lifecycle management, and audit requirements.

• Experience with business process mapping, stakeholder workshops, gap assessments, and requirements documentation.

• Familiarity with SQL, relational databases, data lineage concepts, and enterprise data architectures.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Skills**

• Exposure to pharmaceutical R&D or scientific research data ecosystems.

• Experience with data governance/catalog platforms such as Collibra, Informatica, Alation, or equivalent.

• Understanding of GDPR, retention policies, contractual compliance, and internal data governance standards.

• Experience working with Jira, Confluence, Visio, or BPMN modeling tools.

**Expected Deliverables**

• Current-State Data In-Licensing Process Assessment.

• Stakeholder and System Interaction Mapping.

• End-to-End Process and Governance Gap Analysis.

• DBoM Business Requirements and Metadata Definition.

• Access Control, Entitlement, Retention, and Deletion Requirements.

• Auditability and Data Traceability Requirements.

• Future-State Process Recommendations.

• Prioritized Business Requirements and Remediation Roadmap. Primary Outcome: A comprehensive understanding of business and governance gaps, with actionable recommendations to establish an efficient, compliant, and traceable data in-licensing process.

jobs.title: Technical Business Analyst I
jobs.description:
**Location:**
Hyderabad, India
  
  
Are you passionate about bridging the worlds of data, AI, and business to drive meaningful impact in the Life & Health reinsurance space? Do you thrive at the intersection of analytical rigour, quality thinking, and stakeholder collaboration? If so, this could be the role for you.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Technical Business Analyst within Life & Health Re, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and delivering AI-driven capabilities that are transforming how Swiss Re manages and monitors its global L&H portfolio. You will act as the critical bridge between business stakeholders, AI/data teams, and technology delivery — ensuring that solutions are not only well-specified and rigorously tested, but trusted, adopted, and built to last. This is a high-impact role at the heart of one of Swiss Re's most exciting strategic initiatives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and nurture trusted relationships with internal L&H business partners across underwriting, in-force management, operations, and actuarial functions
* Collaborate with stakeholders to brainstorm ideas, shape use cases, and define MVP scope aligned with the long-term AI product vision
* Capture and document complex business requirements, translating them into clear, actionable functional and non-functional specifications that reflect real business value and operational realities
* Analyze business problems using data-driven approaches, leveraging SQL-based analysis to uncover insights and support decision-making
* Translate business requirements into structured analytical thinking, working closely with AI and data teams to ensure model outputs, recommendations, and reasoning align with business expectations
* Support validation of AI-enabled insights, dashboards, and workflows from a business and functional perspective
* Define and execute functional test scenarios for data, analytics, and AI-enabled solutions, ensuring solutions meet agreed business requirements
* Perform UAT and functional testing, analyzing defects, identifying root causes, and collaborating with delivery teams to propose effective solutions
* Ensure high-quality releases through structured test planning and execution
* Support defect resolution, production incident analysis, and problem management, acting as a business-facing point of contact during early production usage
* Participate in go-live readiness activities, including validation, sign-offs, and post-go-live support to ensure adoption and stability
* Step up during peak cycles, demonstrating flexibility and dependability to meet critical delivery deadlines

**About The Team**
Life & Health Data & Analytics Engineering is a strategic technology partner for Swiss Re's Life & Health Reinsurance division — and we are just getting started. Sitting at the forefront of transforming the data landscape, the team builds innovative analytical products and capabilities that enable better, faster, data-driven decisions across the entire business value chain. As part of the broader Advance with AI initiative, the team is actively building and delivering AI-driven capabilities across end-to-end L&H operations and in-force management — leveraging Swiss Re's rich global data foundation and enterprise business applications to enable continuous portfolio monitoring, actionable insights, and reasoning-enabled workflows in a regulated environment.
  
  
**About You**
You are a curious, detail-oriented professional who brings both analytical depth and strong communication skills to everything you do. You are equally comfortable diving into data as you are facilitating a requirements workshop with senior business stakeholders. You take quality seriously — not as a checkbox, but as a mindset — and you bring structure, rigour, and a collaborative spirit to complex, fast-moving delivery environments. You are energised by the opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI solutions and are motivated by seeing your work make a real difference in how business decisions are made.
  
  
**We Are Looking For Candidates Who Meet These Requirements**

* 2–3 years of hands-on business analysis and data analysis experience, with a proven ability to translate complex business needs into clear functional specifications
* Strong functional testing and QA background within complex data or technology solutions, including experience defining test scenarios, performing UAT, and managing defect resolution
* Hands-on SQL experience for data analysis, validation, and investigation within data platforms or analytics environments
* Life & Health insurance or reinsurance domain experience, with an understanding of underwriting, in-force management, or actuarial workflows
* Experience working with data platforms, analytics solutions, or AI-enabled products, with the ability to validate outputs and support business adoption

**These Are Additional Nice To Haves**

* Exposure to AI / GenAI concepts, including prompt engineering, and an interest in how these technologies are applied in a business context
* Experience supporting AI-driven decision support or monitoring solutions
* Familiarity with model governance, explainability, or regulatory expectations in a data or AI context
* Exposure to in-force management, portfolio analytics, or underwriting workflows
* Experience working in large, global enterprise environments with cross-functional, agile delivery teams
* Familiarity with structured stakeholder management in complex, matrixed organizations

**Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.**

Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.

* Ensure that the reverse-engineering and modernization solution complies with enterprise architecture standards, customer security policies, source-code handling requirements, data-protection controls, audit requirements, and applicable regulatory obligations

* Expertise in RPG III, RPG IV, and RPGLE, including hands-on development, maintenance, and refactoring of large-scale legacy applications

* Skills in DDS, DSPFs, and SQL, including designing, interpreting, and optimizing display files, physical/logical files, and complex queries
* Background in Db2 for i, covering database design, performance tuning, journaling, stored procedures, triggers, and DDS-to-DDL conversion
* Understanding of IBM i architecture, including libraries, objects, service programs, printer files, commitment control, and integrated file systems

* Familiarity with modernization strategies such as API enablement, web-service integration, UI modernization, application decomposition, cloud migration, and re-platforming
* Competency in application portfolio assessment, technical debt evaluation, code quality analysis, and modernization readiness reviews
* Capability to collaborate with AI Tools teams by defining requirements, validating analysis logic, refining prompts, and improving AI-generated documentation and code insights
* Flexibility to support delivery activities, including proofs of concept, effort estimation, project planning, risk identification, and executive-level presentations
* Showcase of strong stakeholder management skills to engage IBM i SMEs, application owners, business analysts, cloud architects, and technical leadership across client and internal organizations
* Qualifications in governance and compliance, ensuring adherence to enterprise architecture standards, security policies, data-protection controls, and regulatory obligations
* Proficiency in English at an Upper-Intermediate level (B2) or higher

jobs.title: Product Manager, Google Play App Safety Platform
jobs.description:
For Singapore Applicants:  
Google will be prioritizing applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require Google's sponsorship of a visa.  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Singapore; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc).
* Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in a technology or business related field.
* 3 years of experience in a business function or role (e.g., strategic marketing, business operations, consulting).
* Experience with mobile app security, app store ecosystems, or content moderation platforms.
* Technical familiarity with LLM security evaluation, AI threat models (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLMs), or static/dynamic code analysis tools.
* Strong data-driven mindset with experience defining and optimizing multi-objective platform metrics (safety vs. speed vs. operational cost).

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  

The App and Ecosystem Trust (AET) team ensures safe, secure, and trustworthy experiences across our global app ecosystem. Mokka is the core review engine that processes every app submission, update, and runtime signal to protect billions of users from security vulnerabilities, policy violations, and malicious behavior.  
  
As the Product Manager for Mokka, you will take the lead on driving the overall strategy and tactical execution of our next-generation review infrastructure. Your core mission is to bridge advanced ML-driven detection capabilities with developer velocity, ensuring our entire ecosystem remains secure without unnecessary friction.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Define the multi-year product roadmap for Mokka, the app safety review platform, to scale under submission volume increases driven by AI-assisted code generation (vibe coding).
* Architect automated static, dynamic, and LLM-assisted review pipelines that intercept modern security threats before apps reach production. Design robust defenses against emerging AI vulnerabilities, including malicious model weights, indirect prompt injection vectors, agentic permission escalation, and generative privacy leaks.
* Balance friction-free onboarding for legitimate developers with rigorous verification checks for high-risk or automated app factories.
* Partner with Operations and Policy teams to design intelligent human-in-the-loop review interfaces, leveraging generative AI assistants to speed up analyst workflows and reduce manual cognitive load.
* Partner closely with ML Research, Security Engineering, Policy Operations, and Developer Relations across global sites (US, Bangalore, London, Singapore) and drive alignment across vertical AET teams (e.g. Content, Malware)

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Front End Engineer II
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Like to develop real-time, distributed, large-scale, and modern front-end applications? Like to craft interfaces that are not just fast and reliable but intuitive, accessible, and a pleasure to use? Like to interact with worldwide advertising customers to build systems that make advertising and its billing frictionless? Familiar with front-end development technologies such as JavaScript, ReactJS, AngularJS, HTML5 and CSS3 and front-end design patterns? Interested in being part of a worldwide Advertising Customer Experience team? Then, the Software Development team that builds Tier-1 customer-facing front-end Advertising Experiences wants you!  
  
Advertising is one of the fastest growing businesses within Amazon, empowering Amazon Sellers, Vendors, Authors, and Publishers to boost their product reach and sales through performance and display advertising.  
  
The Ads Billing platform is an enabler for Amazon Advertising's worldwide rapid growth and offers a singular platform to manage all of the advertiser-facing functions like billing, invoicing, accounting automation, budgets, promotions, payments, and the Billing Advertiser Experience (AX) in real-time while being transparent and auditable from the ground up. As a part of this high-energy, entrepreneurial team you will get an opportunity to innovate on solutions that control the very levers of our advertisers' experience and have the satisfaction of seeing your work impact multiple advertising businesses and bring in multi-million transactions worth 100x in dollar value on a daily basis. This platform owns these mandates for worldwide advertising displayed On or Off Amazon.  
  
The Ads Billing team is looking for a Front-End Engineer to build global, scalable, extensible, and secure front-end applications for Billing, Budgeting, Payments, and Promotions Advertiser Experience (AX). These applications have to seamlessly interact with different downstream ad serving platforms, billing and budgeting systems across a broad variety of advertisement programs with no loss in information, and they build the customer-facing experiences that make billing, budgeting, and payments for advertising frictionless. The platform has to guarantee a latency SLA of milliseconds so that the real-time experience of advertisers is never impacted. Beyond raw performance, these are the surfaces advertisers reach for to understand what they owe, why they owe it, and how to act on it — so the work is as much about clarity, usability, and craft as it is about distributed architecture. To build this platform you will need to be well versed in high-performance and distributed front-end architecture, and care deeply about the experience on the other side of the screen.  
  
Key Technical Challenges:

**About the role**  
  
We are hiring a Product Manager — Household Data Products to own a portfolio of data products within Target's Household product line: from household definitions and taxonomy, through certified datasets, pipelines, quality and governance, to the applications that Media, Promotions, Merchandising and Loyalty teams use to make decisions.  
  
Household is how Target understands its guests as the real-world units that shop together. This role takes the household foundation and turns it into trusted, reusable data products and decision-ready applications — answering questions like which households we acquired, retained or reactivated, what drove it, and how we should market, promote and assort for them.  
  
This is a hands-on role that works closely with Data Engineering, Analytics, Data Science, Identity and business partners. You will partner with DE day-to-day across a medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) architecture, shape schemas and data contracts, and make sure household data products are trusted, well-governed and adopted. The core job is to translate technical capability into business outcomes.  
  
**What you’ll own**  
  
**Household Foundations – Must Have**  
  
You will help build and own the household foundation layer that every downstream use case depends on: stable, certified household datasets built on the enterprise household identity (owned by the Identity team), with consistent definitions that business partners can trust and reuse.

* Household lifecycle definitions and formats — acquisition, retention, reactivation and new-to-category — agreed with Analytics and Finance and published as certified data products.
* Household attributes and taxonomy — life stage, composition, demographics, interests and purchase behaviour, including third-party enrichment — with clear ownership, lineage and refresh cadence.
* Household-level enterprise KPIs such as household-based conversion, taken from definition through UAT, sign-off and production.

**Household Applications – Must Have**  
  
You will help turn the foundation into applications that change decisions across the enterprise, delivering against a roadmap shaped with your manager and business partners:

* Media — map household cohorts to the campaigns they were exposed to, starting with diagnostics and extending to Roundel (retail media) audiences and measurement.
* Promotions — connect households to promotion performance so promo teams can see who a promotion actually reached and moved.
* Merchandising — household views of newness-led acquisition and assortment relevancy by life stage.
* Enterprise growth — an acquisition and reactivation waterfall across drivers (marketing including Roundel, promotions, brand marketing, newness and assortment, new stores), plus who the acquired households are.

**Analytics & Data Fluency — Must Have**  
  
Strong working knowledge of analytics and data concepts, with the ability to partner effectively with Analytics and Data Science teams. You should be comfortable with:

* Household and guest-level analytics, cohorts and segmentation
* Entity resolution and identity concepts (guest-to-household mapping, match rates, stability)
* Data aggregation and dimensional modelling
* Data quality, reconciliation and metric definitions in a semantic layer
* Privacy, consent and responsible use of guest and household data

**Building data products with Data Engineering**  
  
You work hand-in-hand with Data Engineering to turn requirements into real datasets and pipelines — translating business needs into clear specs and data contracts, prioritising the backlog, and making trade-off calls with DE on design, cost and sequencing.  
  
**Platform & ecosystem stewardship**  
  
Solid understanding of our data platform and cloud environment (GCP, BigQuery, Power BI). You make household data easy to discover, access and consume — through the certified gold layer, documented data products and self-serve paths for analysts and downstream platforms.  
  
**Trust, governance & data quality — critical**  
  
Data governance and data quality are central to this role, not an afterthought. Household data drives audience targeting, measurement and executive reporting, so an unstable household ID or a wrong definition ripples across every team that uses it. You own certification, quality monitoring, access and consent controls for the household product line.  
  
**Stakeholder partnership**  
  
You will work with partners across Marketing, Roundel, Loyalty, Promotions and Merchandising to gather requirements, clarify competing asks, and communicate progress, trade-offs and impact clearly to stakeholders and leadership.  
  
**What you’ll bring**

* 3–5 years in product management (or 5+ years in closely related data, analytics or engineering roles with product exposure), with experience on customer or household data products, CDP / customer 360, identity, data platforms, or AdTech/MarTech and retail media.
* Strong understanding of customer and household analytics — lifecycle (acquisition, retention, reactivation), segmentation, cohorts and life-stage modelling.
* Familiarity with identity resolution and householding concepts, and with how household data powers audiences, measurement and personalisation.
* Hands-on experience working closely with Data Engineering to build datasets and pipelines — writing specs, shaping schemas and contracts, and prioritising a technical backlog.
* Solid understanding of medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold) and modern data platforms (lakehouse, data mesh or federated architectures), including lineage and cost.
* Strong grasp of data governance and data quality — certification, monitoring, access, privacy and consent — treated as critical, not optional.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us.

Itron Resiliency Solutions is an innovative business unit within Itron focused on solving mission critical problems for utilities through software and AI. Resiliency Solutions offers unique, market leading solutions for front-line worker safety, storm response, excavation damage prevention, construction management, and many more. These software and AI solutions solve end-to-end challenges for the utilities that power our society and are used by the largest and most complex organizations in the world such as National Grid, Southern Company, and Exelon.

Itron Resiliency Solutions is a global, diverse team of builders and innovators who tackle previously impossible challenges for our customers. If you have a desire to challenge yourself, solve impactful problems, and work with a passionate and talented team, this is the place.

The Emergency Preparedness & Response (EP&R) team builds the systems that keep critical operations running when it matters most. When storms and severe weather threaten communities and infrastructure across the US, our platform enables customers to rapidly procure, mobilize, and manage the workforce needed to respond to and recover from storm damage — often under tight timelines and high-stakes conditions. We are looking for a Principal Engineer who is deeply hands-on, works backward from customer pain points and business needs, and measures success by impact rather than lines of code shipped. You will be the technical anchor of the team: a backend-heavy full-stack engineer who knows our systems inside and out, reasons rigorously about trade-offs, and raises the engineering bar for everyone around you while leading the team toward outcomes that genuinely matter.

**About the role**
------------------

We're hiring a Software Engineer in Bengaluru to build and run production services. You'll own features end to end — from understanding the problem to shipping, monitoring and fixing what you built — with growing independence and support from senior engineers.

Our India engineering team is taking full ownership of core products and growing quickly, including a ground-up rebuild of a customer-critical service. You'll work closely with senior engineers, your Engineering Manager, Product and Customer Support.

**What you'll own in your first year**
--------------------------------------

* **Own:** Own features and services end to end with speed and quality — build, test, release, monitor, fix.
* **Well-scoped problems, then bigger ones.** Start with clearly defined work and grow into breaking down ambiguous problems yourself.
* **Design.** Write design notes for your features and get them reviewed; contribute to larger designs led by senior engineers.
* **Quality.** Write tests, add observability, and take part in on-call so issues are caught before customers see them.
* **Customers.** Understand who uses what you build, and learn from support issues what to fix next.
* **Code reviews.** Give and receive thoughtful reviews, and help onboard engineers who join after you.

**What you must bring**
-----------------------

These are the bar. We can't teach them on the job.

* **Experience:** 1–4 years building production software. We level on demonstrated scope, not years alone.
* **You've shipped code that runs in production.** Features or services you built, released and supported — not only coursework or prototypes.
* **You are strong at problem solving.** You can take an unfamiliar, feature-sized problem, reason through it, and land on a simple, correct solution.
* **You work independently toward a clear goal.** Given a clear goal, you figure out the steps, unblock yourself, and ask for help at the right moments.

We care how you engineer more than which language you did it in.

**Technical background**
------------------------

You've built production software with a modern stack, such as:

* **Cloud:** hands-on with AWS — you've deployed and debugged services running on it.
* **Languages:** strong in at least one modern language such as Python, Java or JavaScript/TypeScript.
* **Frameworks:** modern service frameworks such as FastAPI, Node.js or equivalents.
* **Databases:** solid data modeling and query fundamentals — you can design a schema, use indexes well, and explain why a query is slow and how you'd fix it.
* **Fundamentals:** data structures, API design, and the basics of caching and concurrency.

Exact tools matter less than depth. Strong experience on an equivalent stack is welcome.

**What sets great candidates apart**
------------------------------------

* **Impact you can explain.** You can say what changed because of something you built — for users, performance or reliability.
* **One problem you went deep on.** A bug, a performance issue or a design where you dug past the surface to understand why.
* **Ownership beyond the ticket.** You've fixed what you shipped when it broke, and improved it after release without being asked.
* **Framework mindset:** You notice repeated code and turn it into something reusable.
* **Learning speed.** You've picked up a new domain, codebase or technology quickly and delivered in it.
* **Curiosity about the user.** You've asked why a requirement exists, or suggested a simpler way to solve the user's problem.

**What we look for in everyone we hire**
----------------------------------------

Whatever the role, we hire for six things.

* **Customer obsession.** You care who uses what you build and whether it actually helped them.
* **Impact over activity.** You measure success by outcomes, not tickets closed or lines written.
* **Honesty.** You're specific about your own part in team work, raise problems early, and say what didn't work.
* **Independence.** You don't wait to be told every next step. You figure things out with little hand-holding…

Job Category

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

At Salesforce, we make the tools that help people work more effectively and efficiently. Design and User Experience is at the center of all of it. We bring powerful visions to life with the latest technologies and the Salesforce platform. We put customers first and we're looking for ambitious, self-motivated, creative-minded individuals who want to help shape our products focused on serving powerful actionable intelligence for every business use case.
  
  
You and your team will distill complex problems and propose clear, efficient, consistent solutions. You're meticulous and excited about beautiful design, and you love seeing products ship. You're hungry for new ways to do things. You follow the latest trends, download the newest apps, experiment with the latest devices and wearables. You have a keen eye for useful products, and you share your findings with the team. You're a tireless advocate for the end user. You have deep empathy for their everyday struggles and challenges. You always put their needs first, and you're unwavering in your desire to provide the best experiences for users.
  
  
The ideal candidate enjoys creating experiences with technology, hacking on new projects, and intensely working on high-value, strategic initiatives under tight time constraints. You will have direct access to customer executives and Salesforce executive management, while working closely with the Salesforce Product and Sales organizations. You must have excellent communication skills, energy, and thoughtfulness to build and deliver the best in the world for our customers.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities & Scope**

* Influence and compellingly communicate the UX vision to a wide variety of key stakeholders.
* Build strong partnerships across disciplines, including Design, Product, Engineering, and Marketing.
* Solve complex UX design problems across web, mobile, and tablet platforms.
* Collaborate closely with product owners/managers (POs & PMs) to identify opportunities for new products and features, and validate assumptions through user testing and research.
* Work with engineering teams to deliver polished final products.
* Reinforce a design-thinking culture that leverages the best product, technology, and innovative talent.
* Evangelize new interface guidelines and design patterns.
* Design and maintain scalable design systems (components, patterns, standards) that support consistency across product surfaces.
* Partner with engineering to define how AI agents surface in product workflows, informing when and how agent-driven interactions appear to users.
* Apply design judgment to human-AI interaction patterns, including trust, transparency, explainability, and AI-assisted workflows, as our products become increasingly agent-driven.
Champion responsible design practices — including accessibility, privacy, bias mitigation, and user trust — as foundational expectations for enterprise-grade products.  

**Minimum Requirements**

* 3 to 6 years of experience designing and delivering products in cross-functional teams from start to finish.
* Deep understanding of user-centered design methods and best practices, with a constant drive to improve your process.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative, agile environment while leading process improvement efforts.
* Power to influence others and build consensus while navigating ambiguity.
* Self-motivated, a strong communicator, and able to balance great design with meeting tight deadlines.

**Job Title – Staff Cloud Service Engineer III (Microsoft 365 Email Security & SMTP)** **Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced Email Security & Microsoft 365 Messaging Engineer to own engineering, operation and continuous improvement of enterprise email platform, mail flow and email security services across a global estate. This is a hands-on technical role for a professional who can take ownership of complex incidents and engineering work, not an entry-level or developmental position.

The successful candidate will manage, evolve, support Exchange Online, Microsoft Defender for Office 365, Microsoft Purview, Cisco secure email gateways, SMTP relay services Public DNS configuration and hygiene adhering to industry standards. They will work with security, identity, network and application teams, and with suppliers, to keep email secure, deliverable, compliant and reliable.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the configuration of Cisco secure email gateways, including inbound and outbound routing, policies, quarantine and encryption.
* Design, manage and troubleshoot Exchange Online services, including transport rules, connectors, accepted and remote domains, mailbox and distribution group settings, and migrations.
* Design, configure and optimize Microsoft Defender for Office 365 policies, including anti-spam, anti-phishing with impersonation protection, anti-malware, Safe Links, Safe Attachments and pre-set security policies.
* Own email authentication for all company domains: SPF, DKIM, DMARC
* Design and support SMTP relay and application email services
* Onboard and govern applications, devices (such as multifunction printers and scanners) and SaaS platforms that send email on behalf of company domains, making sure they are authenticated, approved and documented.
* Investigate and remediate phishing, business email compromise, spoofing and malware campaigns with the Security Operations team, using Threat Explorer, message trace, Advanced Hunting and automated investigation and response.
* Monitor mail flow health, deliverability, queue and reputation issues, using Exchange Admin Centre, Defender portal, message trace, Microsoft 365 Service Health and gateway reporting.
* Support Microsoft Purview controls that apply to email: data loss prevention, sensitivity labels, message encryption, retention, eDiscovery and journaling.
* Use ServiceNow and Jira to manage incidents, requests, problems, changes and project activities in line with operational processes.
* Create and maintain designs, runbooks, mail flow diagrams, standards, domain and sender inventories, and knowledge articles.
* Provide clear technical guidance and knowledge transfer to service desk teams, application owners and other engineers.

**Role Scope & Technical Ownership**

This is an experienced engineering role responsible for independently handling complex work, making sound operational decisions and contributing to the technical direction of messaging and email security. It includes broad technical ownership across:

* SMTP relay services for applications, devices and third-party platforms.
* Exchange Online, and mail flow architecture, including routing through secure email gateways.
* Microsoft Defender for Office 365 and the wider email threat protection stack.
* Domain and sender governance: SPF, DKIM, DMARC enforcement and the inventory of approved senders.
* Email-related identity and access controls, including Conditional Access, modern authentication and the removal of legacy protocols.
* Email data protection and compliance with Microsoft Purview.
* Technical leadership during email incidents, including deciding when to block, quarantine, reroute, roll back a change, escalate or engage a specialist.
* Global service delivery, Incident, Change and Problem Management, root-cause analysis and preventative actions.
* Automation with PowerShell (Exchange Online, Microsoft Graph), Power Automate and Logic Apps to improve operations and reporting.
* Mentoring less-experienced engineers and service desk teams.

* Hands-on professional experience engineering and supporting Exchange Online in a large enterprise.
* Strong knowledge of mail flow: connectors, transport rules, accepted domains, centralized mail transport, and routing through third-party gateways.
* Experience with mailbox types, shared and resource mailboxes, distribution and Microsoft 365 groups, permissions and migrations.
* Confident use of message trace, Exchange Admin Centre, Microsoft 365 Service Health and Microsoft support escalation.

**Email Security**

* Practical experience configuring and tuning Microsoft Defender for Office 365
* Experience administering secure email gateway
* Detailed understanding of SPF, DKIM, DMARC, ARC, MTA-STS and TLS, and experience moving domains to DMARC enforcement.
* Experience investigating phishing, spoofing and business email compromise with Security Operations teams.
* Working knowledge of email encryption, data loss prevention and sensitivity labels in Microsoft Purview.

**SMTP & Application Email**

* Deep understanding of SMTP: the protocol, headers, response codes, TLS negotiation, MX and DNS records, and bounce (NDR) analysis.
* Experience designing and supporting SMTP relay for applications and devices, including authenticated submission, connector-based relay and third-party relay services.
* Experience planning and delivering the retirement of Basic Authentication and legacy SMTP AUTH.
* Ability to diagnose deliverability problems blocklists, IP and domain reputation, throttling, and recipient-side rejections.

* Working knowledge of Entra ID, Conditional Access, modern authentication and licensing as they apply to messaging.
* Strong PowerShell skills (Exchange Online module, Microsoft Graph); experience with Power Automate or Logic Apps is desirable.

The role also includes delivering technical changes safely and on time with clear risk and rollback planning. * Resolve call or interaction handling issues through structured troubleshooting and safe production support practices

Keeping voice services reliable

If you want to work on technology that supports how customers reach HSBC every day this role offers real operational impact at scale. You’ll be trusted to restore service quickly, reduce recurrence and deliver change safely across Genesys Engage and Genesys Cloud. The work spans incident response, problem management and technical delivery with close partnership across telephony, infrastructure, security and vendors. Apply to help strengthen the platforms that keep our contact centres running when it matters most.

Technical Product Manager, ServiceNow
  
  
Ecolab is seeking an experienced Technical Product Manager to lead the ServiceNow product roadmap for GBS+ and the enterprise functions it supports.
  
  
GBS+ uses ServiceNow to manage cases, requests, approvals, tasks, service commitments, and operational workflows across Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Legal, and other shared-services functions. As the product continues to expand, we need a leader who can bring these areas together around a consistent case-management model without forcing every function into the same process.
  
  
You will serve as the technical product owner for GBS+ capabilities built primarily on ServiceNow Customer Service Management. You will work with business product managers, process owners, Architecture, Engineering, UX, Data, Enterprise AI, QA, Delivery, and Operations to shape the roadmap and turn business needs into practical platform capabilities.
  
  
This role requires strong CSM knowledge and sound product judgment. You should be able to recognize when a request fits within native ServiceNow capabilities, when an existing pattern should be reused, and when a proposed solution creates unnecessary customization or long-term support risk.
  
  
This is not a project-management or requirements-documentation role. You will own product direction, roadmap priorities, functional decisions, adoption, and product health. You will stay engaged from discovery through delivery, launch, support, and continuous improvement.
  
  
Reporting to the Senior Manager of ServiceNow Technical Product Management, this role will help expand GBS+ while keeping it aligned with the broader ServiceNow platform strategy.
  
  
What’s in It for You
  
  

* Shape the ServiceNow roadmap for GBS+ and enterprise shared services.

* Stay current on relevant ServiceNow releases and bring practical recommendations into the roadmap.
* Manage the lifecycle of CSM capabilities, including introduction, adoption, enhancement, standardization, consolidation, and retirement.
