jobs.title: Product Owner (Packaging industry/domain)
jobs.description:
**Job purpose:**

The Product Owner is the execution arm of the product team and is accountable for translating product direction, roadmap initiatives, and customer needs into clearly defined, prioritised, and deliverable work for Agile development teams. The role owns the product backlog and sprint-level execution, ensuring that development teams understand what needs to be built, why it matters, and how successful delivery will be validated.

**Core responsibilities:**

Product Backlog and Prioritization

* Own, maintain, groom, and prioritise the product backlog, ensuring alignment with product goals, customer needs, business value, and delivery dependencies.
* Lead backlog refinement and ensure items are clearly defined, appropriately sized, prioritised, and ready for development.
* Assess feature requests, enhancements, defects, and competing demands; recommend sequencing and trade-offs in collaboration with the Product Manager.

Requirements and User Stories

* Translate roadmap initiatives and customer or business needs into epics, user stories, workflows, business rules, and clear acceptance criteria.
* Break down complex initiatives into manageable increments that can be delivered and validated through Agile sprints.
* Clarify functional behaviour, use cases, edge cases, and dependencies for Engineering and QA.
* Review completed work against acceptance criteria and confirm whether the agreed requirements have been met.

Agile Delivery and Team Enablement

* Work as the product domain expert and primary point of contact for the development team on backlog scope and requirement clarification.
* Participate actively in sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and other relevant Agile ceremonies; support the team in maintaining sprint-level momentum.
* Monitor sprint goals, backlog readiness, scope changes, and cross-team dependencies, escalating risks through the appropriate channels.
* Partner with Engineering and QA to support feature validation, quality, and delivery against agreed priorities.

Customer and Stakeholder Collaboration

* Work with Product Managers and relevant customer-facing teams to understand customer feedback and translate it into actionable product backlog items.
* Drive early feedback on new features and incorporate validated insights into backlog refinement and prioritization.
* Communicate priorities, scope decisions, requirement changes, and delivery expectations clearly to cross-functional stakeholders.
* Build alignment where stakeholders have competing needs, using product priorities and customer value to guide recommendations.

Continuous Improvement and Senior-Level Contribution

* Identify opportunities to improve story quality, backlog health, team collaboration, and product delivery practices.
* Use delivery and quality feedback to identify recurring requirement gaps, reduce avoidable rework, and improve sprint readiness.
* Share product domain knowledge and provide guidance or mentorship to less experienced Product Owners and team members, where applicable.

Role Focus and Responsibility Boundaries

* Maintain focus on product backlog ownership, requirement clarity, and sprint-level product execution in alignment with the Product Manager/CPO.
* Tier 2 support and technical triage are owned by Support/DevOps teams; project management and Scrum Master responsibilities by Delivery roles; customer demos and training by Enablement/Presales; and code contribution by Development teams.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Required experience and skills:**

* 8+ years of experience in Product Ownership, product delivery, software product development, or a closely related role, with substantial hands-on Product Owner experience.
* Mandatory: Relevant experience in the Packaging industry/domain, with specific exposure to CLF (Cartons, Labels & Flexibles). Understanding of packaging workflows, products, and industry-specific business processes is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience owning and prioritizing product backlogs for software products, ideally within a global SaaS or enterprise software environment.
* Strong capability in writing epics and detailed user stories, defining measurable acceptance criteria, and translating customer needs and roadmap initiatives into development-ready work.
* Proven experience working with Agile/Scrum development teams and contributing effectively to sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Ability to prioritize competing requirements by considering customer impact, business value, product priorities, effort, and dependencies.
* Experience working closely with Product Managers, developers, QA, Support, Implementation, and other cross-functional stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle, Agile delivery practices, and product quality/acceptance processes.
* Ability to act as a domain expert for delivery teams, resolve requirement ambiguity, facilitate decisions, and communicate scope and priority changes effectively.
* Experience with JIRA and familiarity with Confluence, Agile boards, backlog tools, and customer feedback tools.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, organization, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, globally distributed SaaS business.
* Experience mentoring colleagues or improving product ownership practices is an advantage.
* Business-level English proficiency (written and verbal) required.

**We’re looking for a Business Analyst**

Snabbit is India’s first Quick-Service App delivering home services in just 10 minutes through a hyperlocal network of trained and verified professionals. Backed by Elevation Capital, Nexus Venture Partners, and Lightspeed, Snabbit is redefining the home services space by combining speed, quality, and trust.

Founded by Aayush Agarwal, Snabbit is on a mission to make home services as seamless and instant as ordering groceries. We’ve already completed thousands of jobs with exceptional customer satisfaction — and we’re just getting started.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a sharp, analytical, and execution-oriented Business Analyst to help solve complex business problems and support data-driven decision-making across Snabbit.

You will work closely with cross-functional teams—including Operations, Marketing, Category, Product, Growth, and Finance—to identify opportunities, track business performance, improve processes, and drive high-impact initiatives. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with data, finding patterns, and converting insights into measurable business outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Analyse business performance across cities, categories, and customer segments.
* Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and performance trackers for key business metrics.
* Identify trends, gaps, and opportunities through structured data analysis.
* Translate complex datasets into clear, actionable recommendations for business teams.
* Work closely with Marketing, Operations, Product, Growth, Category, and Finance teams on strategic projects.
* Track metrics such as demand, fulfillment, customer retention, service quality, productivity, and unit economics.
* Conduct root-cause analyses to understand performance deviations and operational challenges.
* Support business planning, forecasting, target setting, and performance reviews.
* Design and evaluate experiments aimed at improving customer experience, operational efficiency, and business growth.
* Automate recurring reports and improve the accuracy and efficiency of decision-making processes.
* Take end-to-end ownership of analytical projects—from defining the problem to implementing and measuring solutions.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Business, or a related discipline.
* 4-6 years of experience in business analytics, strategy, operations, consulting, or a similar role.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a structured approach to ambiguous problems.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
* Working knowledge of SQL and experience analyzing large datasets.
* Familiarity with visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or Metabase.
* Strong business judgment and the ability to connect data insights with business outcomes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and operate effectively in a fast-paced startup environment.
* High ownership, attention to detail, and a bias for action.

**Good to Have**

* Experience in a consumer internet, marketplace, hyperlocal, logistics, or high-growth startup.
* Exposure to Python or other analytical tools.
* Understanding of marketplace metrics, customer funnels, operational efficiency, and unit economics.
* Experience working directly with senior business stakeholders.
